review_mode: host-agent review using Open Code Review delegation
deterministic_tool: ocr delegate preview/rule; no OCR LLM endpoint was called
base: main (workspace branch includes the already reviewed approval replay fix)
review_focus: current requester, worker, owner, epoch, Policy, approval and plan are revalidated before durable writes
executing is committed before the adapter call; cancellation or result commit failure cannot make a reservation dispatchable again
unknown, failed and succeeded histories never invoke the adapter a second time
successful coupon, saga, ledger and event projections share one Business transaction
the adapter is restricted to the exact network-free InMemoryCouponBatchAdapter; this does not prove real external fencing
test_file_filter_note: OCR default rules excluded the integration test path; the host manually reviewed the complete test file and its race/failure assertions.
limitations: No independent reviewer was used or claimed.
PostgreSQL, a real external Adapter, Graph recovery and S2 were not part of this slice.
